summary: Bounded copula-genitive and abstract prepositional-object contexts extend the ordinary provider.
Finite-pronoun agreement and possible-postverbal-subject vetoes protect existing verb/object contexts.
Governed phrases retain complete competing gender/case repairs as 2–8 alternatives instead of splicing independent word guesses.
Literal quotation protection expands to explicitly described citations.
Editor phrase corrections apply changed words separately to preserve individual styles and tracked history; native noun/verb findings keep their existing generic edit path.

scoring_review.multiple_choice_behavior: W6 arm records every finding, applies only singleton replacements, sets all_choices_resolved=false for any multiple-choice finding, and cannot score that arm exact.
scoring_review.choice_order: Incoming phrase alternatives are ordered by grammatical gender, explicitly not semantic confidence. Never adopt replacements.first or choose an alternative using expected output for W6.
scoring_review.interpretation: Ambiguous baseline detections may improve review coverage without earning unique exact-correction credit. Report those findings as choices; do not describe their unresolved exact score as absence of baseline detection.
scoring_review.merge: Full phrase findings retain primary precedence. Raw native valid/guard findings are counted independently even if suppressed during merging.
scoring_review.editor: Pure string scoring is unaffected by per-word formatting application; editor controls remain a separate gate.

private_dependency_review.literal_ranges_note: The one expanded quotation pattern is covered by the native planner existing whole-request quote veto.

provenance_followup: Incoming historical morphology completion/adjudication corpus metadata should be reconciled with any all-current-corpora overlap claim; implementation/review agents must not inspect W6 qualification content.
conclusion: No scoring or native-planner change required. Use amended deterministic baseline pins and rerun package checks on the merged source before sealing.
